questions.q: In "Know your customer and market Analyse", which of these is a key idea?
o: Write who does what in an emergency, and rehearse it once a quarter.
Add one proof for each promise: a sample, a test result, a guarantee or a customer record.
List five rivals or substitutes within reach. For each, record price, strength, weakness and how people reach it.
Test the plan: what if sales fall by a quarter, or cost rises by a tenth?

questions.q: In "Rules, registration and data duties in Brazil Understand", which of these is a key idea?
o: Add one proof for each promise: a sample, a test result, a guarantee or a customer record.
Consumer law gives buyers clear rights on information, returns and complaints. Put your terms in plain Portuguese.
Build a growth path: what a new person can do in week 1, month 3 and month 12.
In export and import business: Order flow: quote, contract, production, inspection, booking, customs, delivery, payment.

questions.q: In "Design the offer Create", which of these is a key idea?
o: Price from cost upward and from customer value downward, then pick a price inside both.
Choose three measures: speed, quality (errors per 100) and customer rating. Review them every week.
In export and import business: Train staff on documents and deadlines; one error can hold a container.
Make a 12-month cash plan. Cash timing matters as much as profit: customers may pay late, suppliers may want money first.

questions.q: In "Run the work step by step Apply", which of these is a key idea?
o: Consumer law gives buyers clear rights on information, returns and complaints. Put your terms in plain Portuguese.
Interview at least eight real customers with open questions. Record exact words, not your summary.
Write a simple one-page terms sheet: what is included, what is extra, how to cancel.
Write a one-page standard procedure per stage: who, what, tool, time, record.

questions.q: In "Safety, quality and risk Evaluate", which of these is a key idea?
o: Consumer law gives buyers clear rights on information, returns and complaints. Put your terms in plain Portuguese.
Choose three measures: speed, quality (errors per 100) and customer rating. Review them every week.
Pick one growth lever at a time: new customers, a higher repeat rate, a better price, or a new offer.
Keep an incident and near-miss log. Near-misses are free lessons.

questions.q: In "People, skills and service Apply", which of these is a key idea?
o: Test the plan: what if sales fall by a quarter, or cost rises by a tenth?

Set service rules for answering customers: reply times, tone, how to apologise and fix.
In export and import business: Classify goods with the common customs code, check licences, and use a licensed customs broker where required.
